controls.description: Size-constrained spherical illustration at the primary-only 838 ±44 km ALMA/NEATM estimate. This value is from a 2025 conference abstract; no resolved three-axis shape is provided. Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
